top_choice_rationale: P001 (Buchwald and Hartwig, ligand-controlled Pd-catalysed C-N cross-coupling) has the clearest underlying principle (rate of C-N reductive elimination versus beta-hydride elimination solved by ligand design), about thirty years of independent confirmation, routine industrial use, and the cleanest two-laureate attribution; it is distinct from the 2010 C-C coupling prize and can be explained in one sentence, with Kosugi's precursor handled in the citation wording. P004 (lipid design principle, Cullis, Hope, Madden) is next for impact and a pKa-based physical-chemical mechanism, but its attribution is contested and the 2023 Medicine prize overlaps. P003 pairs two unrelated achievements but each has generative reach; P002 is more platform engineering with crowded credit.
